title: Kaya Toast & Soft-Boiled Egg Keycap Clicker
description: A kopitiam breakfast in miniature. Press the grill-marked toast with pandan kaya and butter, or swap in a soft-boiled egg with a golden yolk and a splash of soy sauce.
dimensions: 40.4 × 36 mm saucer · 33.8 mm egg dish across
printNote: Open the colour 3MF as a project in Bambu Studio. Match filaments 1–4 to green, brown, cream and yellow on your AMS Lite. If you already have the saucer and full-height MX-style switch from No. 2 or No. 8, select just the caps to print. For a new set, add a switch and a split ring. Test the stem fit after printing.
